audience: Studio owners following up on overdue invoices
primary_task: Find an overdue invoice, inspect its history, and prepare a reminder
scope: Review the existing implementation and any supplied screenshots; do not build a replacement
constraints: Retain the current brand, framework, useful components, and working behavior
A sound design can receive a Keep verdict with no changes recommended
Distinguish observed defects from optional taste preferences
Suggest the smallest effective correction before a structural rethink
Mark runtime and visual checks unverified when the relevant tools or artifacts are absent
acceptance: Review gives a concise evidence-based verdict and specific strengths to keep
Any correction includes its location, user impact, smallest fix, and verification
No file edits, dependency installation, or redesign begins during the review
A proposed better implementation explains why a simpler correction is insufficient
